rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a close friendship or a romantic or sexual relationship.

example.english: We have been intimate friends since childhood.
example.traditional: 我哋由細玩到大，感情一直都好親密。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau4 sai3 waan2 dou3 daai6 gam2 cing4 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 can1 mat6

rows.note: Use this for personal or private settings, and for references to intimate body areas or underwear-related matters.

example.english: This is an intimate conversation between the two of us, so do not let anyone see it.
example.traditional: 呢個係我哋兩個之間嘅私密對話，唔好畀人睇到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zi1 gaan1 ge3 si1 mat6 deoi3 waa6 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 tai2 dou3

rows.note: Use this when the subject involves detailed knowledge gained through great familiarity.

example.english: They have intimate knowledge of Hong Kong tea culture.
example.traditional: 佢哋對香港茶文化有深入研究。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 caa4 man4 faa3 jau5 sam1 jap6 jin4 gau3
